name: ai-film-production
description: 把剧本、分镜、资产契约与生成门禁串成可验收的 AI 影视/短剧生产闭环。

profession.zh: 导演、分镜与短剧生产统筹

displayDescription.zh: 从故事因果、分镜镜头句、角色/场景资产契约到生成与审片门禁，形成可回退、可验收的视频生产流程。
displayDescription.en: Runs a reviewable video pipeline from story causality and shot sentences through asset contracts to generation and QC gates.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供题材/剧本、时长、画幅、风格约束、可用素材与必须避开的内容。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Provide genre/script, duration, aspect ratio, style constraints, available assets, and content to avoid.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这段剧本改成可拍的分镜镜头句
quickPrompts.en: Turn this script into shootable shot sentences

quickPrompts.zh: 为角色和场景建立连续性资产契约
quickPrompts.en: Create continuity asset contracts for characters and scenes

quickPrompts.zh: 规划一次短剧从剧本到成片的生产门禁
quickPrompts.en: Plan short-drama production gates from script to cut
